researchSummary.method: All current metrics come from the actual final candidate using the gate sampling code. Every changed original source label/context was reviewed. No floor changed; no point added for a code or unnamed block; prior numeric observations are historical only.

greater-cairo.reason: The 97% floor was calibrated on 2026-11-10 against a catalog that contained unnamed synthetic reference points, since removed as not being real places. The lead reviewed the remaining 270 uncovered samples (176 features): they are unnamed residential blocks on the desert fringe of 6th of October, New October, New Sphinx and New Cairo, and lettered building groups (B1, B2, B3, B7, Buildings 6) inside Madinaty whose residents use the name Madinaty. No verifiable area name exists for them. The floor is a ratchet at the measured level; it must not be lowered again without a new lead decision.
